top_signals.title: Kganyago: SARB Expects S. Africa CPI to Decline in 2027
top_signals.summary: South African Reserve Bank Governor Lesetja Kganyago says they will make their policy decisions meeting by meeting. He spoke to Bloomberg’s Avril Hong on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank meeting in Bangkok ahead of the SARB’s final policy meeting of the year, next month. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: IMF Quite Confident Argentina Able to Meet 2027 Debt Obligations
top_signals.summary: The International Monetary Fund is “quite confident” that Argentina’s authorities are in a position to meet next year’s debt obligations, said Luis Cubeddu, deputy director of the Western Hemisphere department.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Delhi Police Tighten Security Ahead of ‘Cockroach’ Rally
top_signals.summary: Authorities in New Delhi are bracing for another confrontation over India’s contentious voter-roll revision, with police set to restrict a planned demonstration by the youth-led Cockroach Janta Party.

top_signals.title: CoreWeave’s bonds scream financial distress
top_signals.summary: The company better hurry up figuring out how to tap insurers for cash

top_signals.title: Balaji’s ‘Singapore of social media’ begins with a wave of bans
top_signals.summary: Network School founder Balaji Srinivasan wants to turn Farcaster into a haven for well-mannered techno-optimists. He had to do a bit of housekeeping first.
